# Release Template for GitHub Releases

Use this template when creating a new GitHub release.

---

## Release Title
`Campus Connect Pre-Alpha v0.1.0` (or appropriate version)

## Tag
`v0.1.0-pre-alpha` (or appropriate tag)

## Release Description

Copy the relevant sections from `RELEASE_NOTES_PRE_ALPHA.md` or create a summary:

```markdown
## 🎯 Overview

[Brief description of the release]

## ✨ Key Features

- Feature 1
- Feature 2
- Feature 3

## 🚀 What's New

- New feature 1
- New feature 2

## ⚠️ Known Limitations

- Limitation 1
- Limitation 2

## 📦 Installation

[Link to installation instructions or copy from README]

## 📖 Documentation

- [README](README.md)
- [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md)

## 🔗 Links

- **Repository:** [GitHub Repository URL]
- **Issues:** [GitHub Issues URL]
- **Documentation:** [Documentation URL if available]

## 📝 Full Release Notes

See [RELEASE_NOTES_PRE_ALPHA.md](../RELEASE_NOTES_PRE_ALPHA.md) for complete release notes.
```

---

## Assets to Attach (if applicable)

- Source code (zip)
- Source code (tar.gz)
- Any additional documentation or assets

**Note:** This is a template. Customize it based on the specific release.
